correctness.rationale: Rechecked the corrected summable-spectrum claim and proof in repairs/2/RESULT.md. Full-support one-coordinate laws have the stated weak isotropy; sketch magnitude and sign do not affect the coordinate range. Independence and Tonelli give sum_j j^(-rho)(1-pi_j)^L. For L>=2 the cutoff equation has a unique root because its sum is continuous, strictly increasing above 1, and unbounded. Supporting-line slopes at the cutoff law are -L t^(-rho) on the support and at least this slope off it. Derivative sums are absolutely convergent by the probability l1 bounds. Strict coordinate convexity gives the unique closed-simplex optimizer, with finite support; full-support mixtures approach it by dominated convergence and cannot attain it. Substituting yields (m-1)t^(-rho) plus the squared-singular-value tail. The root diverges but is O(1/delta); a decreasing-function integral comparison bounds the discretization error by delta(1+log t), so t delta tends to 1. Thus the contributions inside and outside support have leading coefficients 1 and 1/(rho-1) in units of t^(1-rho). The best rank-L residual is the tail after L, giving the required ratio rho^rho. The original two-draw identity also checks: t^rho=1+2^rho lies strictly between 2^rho and 3^rho. The original checker and notes were inspected, not executed; finite coupon and floating-point checks are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: Pass applies only to the repaired sharp Hilbert–Schmidt ratio for a fixed summable infinite spectrum. The original framing of the exact finite-budget allocation as part of the novelty does not survive: it is the deterministic-coverage, one-slot specialization of Błaszczyszyn–Giovanidis and is displayed in equivalent truncated form by Ji–Caire–Molisch. The repaired text cites this exact overlap and uses the allocation as a proof ingredient. In the strongest inspected asymptotic comparisons, the explicit gamma^gamma hit constant is for 0<gamma<1 with a growing finite catalogue; the gamma>1 bounds are order estimates for throughput–outage with an exponential miss objective. Neither result provides the sharp error relative to the rank-L tail in the summable regime. The countably infinite, full-support formulation is necessary for the question but by itself is not the novelty.
residual_risks: Related caching models may contain a sharp summable-regime miss constant in an unlocated derivation or appendix; no blanket priority claim is made.
The correction already credits exact weighted placement and nonsummable related gamma^gamma scaling. It claims neither a new KKT design nor a new orderwise scaling law for networks.

value.rationale: The distinct sharp constant quantifies the price of repeated iid coordinate selection relative to the best rank-L approximation on the same summable spectrum. Even after per-budget optimization the factor can be large; it gives a calibration that a mere decay order, cutoff rule, or coupon-collector example cannot supply. The retained and unretained parts both contribute at leading order, so this benchmark is not obtained by identifying effective support alone.
